components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard action button in primary Cobalt coloring.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-roboto-condensed), sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #3871c1; color: #faf9f6; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: rgba(56, 113, 193, 0.9); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: #3871c1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(56, 113, 193, 0.5); }

components.name: Post Card
components.description: Content card displaying category, date, title, and excerpt.
components.html:
MusicJuly 26, 2026

Video Game Soundtracks

An exploration of how sound design and audio technology shaped early 8-bit games.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background-color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5rem; color: #615766; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-color: #3871c1; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-badge { font-family: var(--font-roboto-condensed), sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-badge-music { background-color: rgba(243, 162, 87, 0.15); color: #f3a257; } .ds-card-time { font-family: var(--font-roboto-condensed), sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: rgba(97, 87, 102, 0.5); } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-lora), Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #615766; margin: 0; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title { color: #3871c1; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: var(--font-roboto-condensed), sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 300; color: rgba(97, 87, 102, 0.7); margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard textual input field for client lead contact forms.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2.25rem; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background-color: transparent; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-nunito), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #615766; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #3871c1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(56, 113, 193, 0.5); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; }

narrative.overview: The Developer's Atelier blends rigorous technical layout structure with warm, hand-crafted editorial details. The visual interface is designed to feel highly customized, clean, and interactive, letting the content lead while presenting a polished, premium aesthetic for potential freelance client leads.
keyCharacteristics: Atelier Editorial: Classic serif fonts for prominent headings and article titles, paired with a soft, readable sans font for body reading.
Warm Contrast Canvas: A default light-mode background on warm paper (#faf9f6) and a deep charcoal orchid dark-mode canvas, accented by cobalt, warm orange, and sage.
Tactile Depth: Clean container grids featuring subtle borders, distinct shadows, and responsive vertical offsets on hover.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Colorful accents (Cobalt, Tangerine, and Sage) must never collectively cover more than 15% of any given viewport layout. Their purpose is to command visual attention to specific details.

rules.name: The Editorial Width Rule
rules.body: Any block of body or prose copy must have a maximum width of 65ch (characters) to guarantee comfortable horizontal eye tracking.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: All interactive card blocks must translate vertically upwards by -4px (transform: translateY(-4px)) and shift shadow state to Elevated Shadow when hovered, returning smoothly when at rest.

dos: Do wrap all article reading text inside container constraints that limit content width to max-w-3xl and max-w-prose.
Do color-code categories consistently using Cobalt (#3871c1) for software, Orange (#f3a257) for music, and Sage (#4a7c59) for games.
Do use a sticky header with a backdrop-blur filter to preserve scroll visibility.
donts: Don't use solid saturated colors for dark backgrounds. Keep dark mode backgrounds to muted tones like oklch(0.145 0 0).
Don't use full-width buttons on desktop screens; restrict their width to the content size or a maximum of max-w-xs.
